title: PoemDeck correction file
description: Shape of a poems/<slug>.md file after its frontmatter and sections are parsed. Enforced in CI; the reader lives in SparkHub at scripts/poemdeck/lib/overlay.ts.

slug.description: Identity key. Must equal the filename and must already exist in PoemDeck — corrections cannot create poems.

正文.description: Body lines. Stored simplified; the traditional view is generated at read time. Line count must match the stored poem — a structural problem belongs in an issue, not here.

拼音.description: One entry per body line. Left out, CI generates it; written explicitly, CI leaves it alone.

注释.description: Term to gloss. Written as `- 词: 解释` list items.

$comment: An empty section counts as absent, not as an instruction to clear the column: the submission template ships blank 注释/译文/赏析 headings, and treating those as a clear would erase the only PoemDeck content that cannot be regenerated from upstream.
